derivation: from an unused root meaning to stretch;
def: properly, extent, i.e. measure; by implication, a dress (as measured)

occurrences.text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
